items.title: 68426_Nellie Lutcher oral history interview
items.q: Peg Leg Bates, I remember him. I think Peg Leg is still around. And I can remember him performing and dancing with this peg leg, you know.

ctx.x: What do you remember about the Whitman Sisters' shows, or about Ida Cox's performance?

Well, I remember they were marvelous shows. This was old fashioned good showmanship, you know. Of course Ida was a blues singer and the Whitman Sisters were dancers. And at that time there was another very, very marvelous performer with the Whitman Sisters, and that was Peg Leg Bates. Peg Leg Bates, I remember him. I think Peg Leg is still around. And I can remember him performing and dancing with this peg leg, you know.
